mentions.name: Scion Exchange
mentions.description: A web and iOS/Android (React Native) platform that lets members of a rare fruit meetup group exchange scions, built to serve the group before being shared more widely.
mentions.audience: Members of the author's rare fruit meetup group, with plans to make it broadly useful before sharing it with others.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building a platform for people in my rare fruit meetup group exchange scions. I've never built a react native app, but with the help of Claude it seems possible to build for the web and iOS/Android apps with minimal experience. Hoping to make it really useful for our group before sharing it with others.

https://www.scion.exchange
